title: Spaces that typed their booking time zone show their open times again, and the time zone is picked from a menu

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21 in production: every Space with booking set up had saved its time zone as typed text, because the availability editor's Timezone field was a free-text box seeded with UTC. danny-kenduck saved 'Los Angelas', danieltyack 'Los Angeles' (window and schedule), house-of-fates 'Pacific' (window and schedule). None is an IANA name, Intl throws on each, and the slot builder skips every day it cannot place, so all three Spaces offered zero open times and production had never taken a booking (space_bookings was empty). Confirmation and reminder emails would also have printed times in UTC.

DONE 2026-11-21: resolveBookingZone (lib/spaces/booking.ts) falls back to the Space's own calendar zone (spaces.time_zone, LIVE-471), then the house zone, never UTC. readWindows repairs an unreadable window zone on read, readSchedule treats one as no zone, and booking-notify does the same for email times. setSpaceAvailability and setSpaceSchedule refuse an unreadable zone, and an availability save now carries its zone onto the schedule (the schedule's zone outranked the windows', so a zone changed in the editor did nothing once a schedule row existed). The editor's Timezone is a menu of the named zones (lib/time/zone-words.ts ZONE_CHOICES) seeded from the Space's calendar zone. No migration: the three Spaces book in Pacific Time from the next deploy, and their stored text is replaced the next time the owner saves.

verify.note: Passes while an unreadable stored zone still yields open times and the editor offers a menu, not a text box.
